03.C Growth in pairs and monoculture

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code
  • View Source

Competition outcomes

Author

Shane Hogle

Published

September 22, 2026

1 Introduction

Strain naming convention: 1287 = Citrobacter koseri 1287, 1977 = Pseudomonas chlororaphis 1977, A = Ancestral/Streptomycin sensitive, E = Evolved/Streptomycin resistant.

Here we compare the growth of each strain in monoculture against its growth when sharing a membrane-separated well with a competitor, across a range of streptomycin concentrations.

2 Setup

2.1 Libraries

Show/hide code 
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(scales)
source(here::here("R", "gcurves.R"))
source(here::here("R", "generic.R"))

2.2 Global variables

Show/hide code 
data_processed <- here::here("data", "processed", "03_coculture_plates")
figs <- here::here("output", "figures")

# make output directories if they don't exist
fs::dir_create(data_processed)
fs::dir_create(figs)

2.3 Functions

This function collects all the data from monocultures and cocultures for the selected species pair. Only monoculture data from streptomycin concentrations tested in co-cultures is included.

Show/hide code 
collect_sp_pairs <- function(df, competition_pair, strep_thresh) {
  strainpairs <- stringr::str_split(competition_pair, "_")[[1]]
  df %>%
    mutate(streptomycin = if_else(plate_name == "plate01", 0, streptomycin)) %>%
    mutate(strainID = make_strainID(evolution, strain)) %>%
    filter(strainID %in% strainpairs) %>%
    filter(str_detect(culture_type, "diffusion", negate = T)) %>%
    filter(streptomycin <= {{ strep_thresh }}) %>%
    filter(
      (culture_type == "coculture" &
        competition_pair == {{ competition_pair }}) |
        culture_type == "monoculture"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      culture_type = factor(
        culture_type,
        levels = c("monoculture", "coculture")
      )
    )
}

This function plots the output from the collect_sp_pairs function.

Show/hide code 
plot_sp_pairs <- function(df, title) {
  df_cl <- df %>%
    mutate(seconds = seconds - seconds %% 1200) %>%
    mutate(hours = seconds / 3600) %>%
    summarize(
      y = mean(OD600_rollmean),
      sd = sd(OD600_rollmean),
      n = n(),
      .by = c(hours, strainID, streptomycin, competition_pair, culture_type)
    ) %>%
    mutate(ymin = y - 1.96 * sd / sqrt(n), ymax = y + 1.96 * sd / sqrt(n))

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = df_cl,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        y = y,
        color = strainID
      ),
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = df_cl,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        fill = strainID,
        group = interaction(strainID, streptomycin, culture_type)
      ),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = df,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        y = OD600_rollmean,
        color = strainID,
        group = interaction(well, plate_name)
      ),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Hours", y = "OD600") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 48, 12),
      labels = seq(0, 48, 12)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      y = "Optical density (600 nm), log scale",
      x = "Hours",
      title = {{ title }}
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = straincols) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = straincols) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 1)) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(culture_type ~ streptomycin) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

2.4 Read data

Show/hide code 
gcurves <- readr::read_tsv(here::here(data_processed, "gcurves_smooth.tsv"))

3 Diffusion test

Plot the co-cultures growing on M9 compared to the control (column 1 and 3). On the plate, column \(n=\{1\dots11\}\) is connected to column \(n+1\) with a 0.22 μm membrane allowing free diffusion of resources and metabolic byproducts but not cells. These experiments were all conducted with no streptomycin.

Show/hide code 
pdiffusiontest <- gcurves %>%
  filter(str_detect(culture_type, "diffusion")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(strain, "NANA", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(aes(
    x = hours,
    y = OD600_rollmean,
    lty = replicate,
    color = culture_type,
    group = interaction(well, plate_name)
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Hours", y = "OD600") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 48, 12),
    labels = seq(0, 48, 12)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Optical density (600 nm)", x = "Hours", title = "Diffusion test") +
  facet_grid(evolution ~ strain) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(
  here::here(figs, "coculture_diffusion_test.svg"),
  plot = pdiffusiontest,
  device = "svg",
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)

# Introduction

Strain naming convention: 1287 = *Citrobacter koseri* 1287, 1977 = *Pseudomonas chlororaphis* 1977, A = Ancestral/Streptomycin sensitive, E = Evolved/Streptomycin resistant.

Here we compare the growth of each strain in monoculture against its growth when sharing a membrane-separated well with a competitor, across a range of streptomycin concentrations.

# Setup

## Libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(scales)
source(here::here("R", "gcurves.R"))
source(here::here("R", "generic.R"))
```

## Global variables

```{r}
data_processed <- here::here("data", "processed", "03_coculture_plates")
figs <- here::here("output", "figures")

# make output directories if they don't exist
fs::dir_create(data_processed)
fs::dir_create(figs)
```

## Functions

This function collects all the data from monocultures and cocultures for the
selected species pair. Only monoculture data from streptomycin concentrations
tested in co-cultures is included.

```{r}
collect_sp_pairs <- function(df, competition_pair, strep_thresh) {
  strainpairs <- stringr::str_split(competition_pair, "_")[[1]]
  df %>%
    mutate(streptomycin = if_else(plate_name == "plate01", 0, streptomycin)) %>%
    mutate(strainID = make_strainID(evolution, strain)) %>%
    filter(strainID %in% strainpairs) %>%
    filter(str_detect(culture_type, "diffusion", negate = T)) %>%
    filter(streptomycin <= {{ strep_thresh }}) %>%
    filter(
      (culture_type == "coculture" &
        competition_pair == {{ competition_pair }}) |
        culture_type == "monoculture"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      culture_type = factor(
        culture_type,
        levels = c("monoculture", "coculture")
      )
    )
}
```

This function plots the output from the `collect_sp_pairs` function.

```{r}
plot_sp_pairs <- function(df, title) {
  df_cl <- df %>%
    mutate(seconds = seconds - seconds %% 1200) %>%
    mutate(hours = seconds / 3600) %>%
    summarize(
      y = mean(OD600_rollmean),
      sd = sd(OD600_rollmean),
      n = n(),
      .by = c(hours, strainID, streptomycin, competition_pair, culture_type)
    ) %>%
    mutate(ymin = y - 1.96 * sd / sqrt(n), ymax = y + 1.96 * sd / sqrt(n))

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = df_cl,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        y = y,
        color = strainID
      ),
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = df_cl,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        fill = strainID,
        group = interaction(strainID, streptomycin, culture_type)
      ),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = df,
      aes(
        x = hours,
        y = OD600_rollmean,
        color = strainID,
        group = interaction(well, plate_name)
      ),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Hours", y = "OD600") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 48, 12),
      labels = seq(0, 48, 12)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      y = "Optical density (600 nm), log scale",
      x = "Hours",
      title = {{ title }}
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = straincols) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = straincols) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 1)) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(culture_type ~ streptomycin) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## Read data

```{r}
gcurves <- readr::read_tsv(here::here(data_processed, "gcurves_smooth.tsv"))
```

# Diffusion test

Plot the co-cultures growing on M9 compared to the control (column 1 and 3). On the plate, column $n=\{1\dots11\}$ is connected to column $n+1$ with a 0.22 μm membrane allowing free diffusion of resources and metabolic byproducts but not cells. These experiments were all conducted with no streptomycin.

```{r}
pdiffusiontest <- gcurves %>%
  filter(str_detect(culture_type, "diffusion")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(strain, "NANA", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(aes(
    x = hours,
    y = OD600_rollmean,
    lty = replicate,
    color = culture_type,
    group = interaction(well, plate_name)
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Hours", y = "OD600") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 48, 12),
    labels = seq(0, 48, 12)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Optical density (600 nm)", x = "Hours", title = "Diffusion test") +
  facet_grid(evolution ~ strain) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(
  here::here(figs, "coculture_diffusion_test.svg"),
  plot = pdiffusiontest,
  device = "svg",
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: true
#| label: fig-01
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Growth curves (OD600 over 48 hours) in monoculture for three replicates (line type) of each species (plot panel columns) and evolution status (plot panel rows). Line color indicates experimental conditions: inoculation into M9 salts with an adjacent well containing sterile R2A growth medium, versus the inverse where cells are inoculated into sterile R2A with an adjacent well containing sterile M9 salts."
pdiffusiontest
```

# Co-culture and monoculture growth

## A1287 + E1287

```{r}
A1287E1287 <- collect_sp_pairs(
  gcurves,
  competition_pair = "A1287_E1287",
  strep_thresh = 256
) %>%
  filter(streptomycin != 10) %>%
  write_tsv(here::here(data_processed, "competition_A1287_E1287_final.tsv"))

pA1287E1287 <- plot_sp_pairs(
  A1287E1287,
  title = "Sensitive 1287 (A1287) + Resistant 1287 (E1287)"
)

ggsave(
  here::here(figs, "A1287_E1287.svg"),
  plot = pA1287E1287,
  device = "svg",
  width = 9,
  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: true
#| label: fig-02
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: Growth curves (OD600 over 48 hours) of two strains in a competing pair (denoted by color and plot title). Columns in the plot grid depict different streptomycin concentrations (μg/ml) under which growth was measured. Grid rows depict whether strains were grown in co-culture (strains inoculated into adjacent wells) or in monoculture (single strain inoculated into well with adjacent well containing sterile media only). Heavy line corresponds to mean growth while lighter lines correspond to individual replicates. The ribbon around each mean line corresponds to the 95% confidence interval (CI) around the mean. Line color corresponds to species/strain identity.
pA1287E1287
```
